title: The Gate of Unity

description: Early 19th-century work by Rabbi Dov Baer Schneuri, the second rebbe of the Chabad-Lubavitch Chasidic movement. Complete Chasidut text imported from Sefaria; the exact edition and licence are shown with each version.
historicalContext: Hasidic literature gathers sermons, letters and teachings from the movement's dynasties and schools. Individual works are attributed to specific rebbes and schools rather than to Chasidut as a whole.
